definitions.gloss: victory podium; medal podium; awards platform
definitions.explanation: The raised platform where winners of a competition stand to receive their medals or prizes. Has three levels for first, second, and third place.

examples.japanese: {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{立|た}つ。
{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}の{一番|いちばん}{上|うえ}に{立|た}ちたい。
examples.english: I want to stand at the top of the podium.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{三回|さんかい}{連続|れんぞく}で{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: She stood on the podium three times in a row.

notes: Composed of {表彰|ひょうしょう} (commendation/award) + {台|だい} (platform/stand). Common collocations: {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{立|た}つ (to stand on the podium), {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{上|あ}がる (to go up on the podium), {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}を{逃|のが}す (to miss the podium). '{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{上|あ}がる' can mean finishing in the top three in general sports contexts.
